summary: The response noted that a noise study showed the Howell Avenue ramps would increase noise by less than 1 dBA, and that the noise abatement strategy on page 150 would reduce noise to acceptable federal levels at lower cost than the proposed tunnel, making the tunnel not economically justifiable.
text:
A study of the increased noise because of the addition of access to Howell Avenue was conducted by the staff of the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transporation Commission. The results show an increase of less than 1 dBA along the Airport Spur. The results of this study are incorporated in this Final EIS. See pages 114 and 115.
See page 150 of this Final Environmental Impact Statement.
The noise abatement strategy outlined on page 150 would reduce the noise to acceptable Federal levels. It would also reduce the adverse impact on air quality and could be done at a lower cost than the proposed tunnel. Therefore, it is not economically justifiable.
